Developmental ToM: cross-task fine-tuning transfer

Each cell is the mean change in log-odds of the correct answer on the test task (columns) after fine-tuning on the train task (rows), relative to the base model. Every cell is scored on held-out stories (4-fold CV over stories), so each item is tested once per seed. Values are averaged over items, then over seeds. Outlined cells are within-task. attn_loc (location attention checks) is evaluated but never trained on.

Correct answers: fb = the protagonist’s belief (start location for False Belief, end location for True Belief); antagonist = end location in both conditions (the antagonist moved the object); attn_agent = the person who placed / moved the object; attn_loc = the start / end location.

Log-odds units: natural log. If a run is incomplete (not all 4 folds), a cell only covers some stories, so compare cells with care.

All models together

Shared color scale, so cells can be compared across models and checkpoints.

Gain by condition

Mean gain for each condition of each test task (fb and antagonist: False vs. True Belief; attention checks: question type). Error bars are ±1 SE across seeds. Orange marks answers that match the protagonist’s outdated view (False Belief, original location); green marks answers that match current reality (True Belief, final location).

How to read a shift toward one location:

  • fb: a general shift toward the end location shows up as False Belief down and True Belief up. If both go up, the change depends on the condition.
  • antagonist: the correct answer is the end location in both conditions, so a general shift toward the end location makes both go up. Compare with fb to tell real agent tracking apart from that shift.

pythia-14m @ final

Attention checks by passage type

Gain on each attention-check question, split by whether it was asked about a False Belief or a True Belief passage. If a fine-tuned model answers based on the type of story rather than the question, it should favor the original location (and the person who placed the object) on False Belief passages, and the final location (and the person who moved it) on True Belief passages, whatever the question asks.

pythia-14m @ final

Accuracy

Change in accuracy (percentage points), where an item counts as correct if the model gives the correct answer higher probability than the incorrect one. Labels show accuracy before → after fine-tuning.

pythia-14m @ final

Explicit vs. implicit probe

Mean gain on fb and antagonist, split by how the final question is worded (explicit “thinks the X is in the” vs. implicit, e.g. “goes to get the X from the”). Error bars are ±1 SE across seeds.

pythia-14m @ final

Item-level: before vs. after

Each point is one item (averaged over seeds): log-odds of the correct answer for the base model (x) and after fine-tuning (y). Points above the diagonal improved; points right of the vertical line were already correct before fine-tuning, and points above the horizontal line are correct after.
